hero.headline: Someone has started writing to you.
hero.subLine1: It’s not a book. It’s not a game.
hero.subLine2: It’s a story that comes home to you, develops with you, letter after letter.

items: And find out what happens next.

letterHistory.title: What stories you are going to live
letterHistory.subtitle: We created an engine that perfectly mixes author-written stories with an interactive playground — scroll to see how it works.
letterHistory.timelineAria: Animated diagram of branching story timelines that converge into an authored path.
letterHistory.step1After: contacts, the system generates characters, events, and places every time — each one different from any other story.
steps: Everybody lives a story that is different from anybody else.
The core story still has a start and an end, written and shaped by a human author — so you get surprises, twists, and an emotional experience comparable to reading a book or watching a movie.

different.title: Why it’s different
items: You have to wait for it

storiesAdmin.title: Stories
storiesAdmin.subtitle: Create and edit interactive letter stories. Optional modules (facts, acts, clues, endings) can stay empty for simple stories.
storiesAdmin.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only (e.g. my_story).
storiesAdmin.confirmDelete: Delete this row? This cannot be undone.
storiesAdmin.activeGamesWarningTitle: This story has games in progress.
storiesAdmin.activeGamesWarningBody: {count} active game(s) use this story. Edits take effect on the next AI generation and may create inconsistencies for players mid-game. Consider duplicating the story and editing the copy instead.

lifecycleHint.draft: Being written. Not playable, not purchasable.
lifecycleHint.testing: Playable by you. Every AI reply waits for your review before the player sees it.
lifecycleHint.released: On sale. AI replies are sent automatically when canon validation passes; problems are held for your review.

startMode.fixed: Fixed date (story always starts on the configured date)
startMode.actual: Actual date (story starts the day the game is created)

hints.personality: Free JSON: traits, speech_pattern, letter_format, techniques…
hints.hiddenAgenda: Secret. Players never see this; only the AI Game Master and this character use it.
hints.openingLetter: Sent automatically when a game starts. Never write the date inside the letter — dates are shown by the platform.
hints.knownBy: Which characters know this fact. Nobody selected + not public = secret only the Game Master knows.
hints.conditions: JSON flags that must match the game state, e.g. {"victim_saved": true}.
hints.firstLetterLegacy: Old single opening letter. Prefer per-character opening letters below; this is used only if no character has one.

errors.invalid_slug: Invalid slug: use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
errors.slug_taken: This slug is already in use.
errors.key_taken: This key/slug is already in use in this story.
errors.publish_requires_released: Only released stories can be published.
errors.publish_needs_contactable_character: To publish, add at least one character contactable from start.
errors.publish_needs_opening_letter: To publish, add an opening letter to at least one character.
errors.delay_max_lt_min: Max delay must be >= min delay.
errors.visible_delay_max_lt_min: Max delivery delay must be >= min.

replyAdmin.guidancePlaceholder: e.g. Make Voss more reassuring; do not mention the autopsy yet.

replyAdmin.testTurnHint: Submits a real player turn for this game (Phase 4 will give players their own UI). The turn then waits in this queue like any player submission.
